items.title: Nintendo’s Ocarina of Time Remake Price Hints at a 1:1 Rehash, Hours Before the Big Zelda Direct

items.title: Intel surpasses one million High-NA EUV wafers processed, outpaces the rest of the industry combined — company also trailblazing giant 6×12 photomasks to speed production and lower costs
items.description: Intel is leading the semiconductor industry with High-NA fleet and process-maturity milestone as it reaches 1 million wafers processed using High-NA tools, moves forward with 6×12 photomask effort.

items.description: Arm’s new Neoverse CSS N4 platform can pack up to 128 cores per die and 256 MB of L3 cache, representing a large increase in support over the previous Neoverse CSS N2 platform.

items.description: With Aion 2's global launch now less than a month away, NC has brought the MMORPG to gamescom 2026 with a straightforward pitch: this is the game the original Aion was always meant to be. items.description: Following my 1-hour long hands-on session with Persona 4 Revival, which immediately brought me back to 2012 when I first played Persona 4 Golden, I had the chance to sit down with Persona series general producer Kazuhisa Wada and art director Akane Kobayashi to talk about the upcoming remake, focusi
items.tldr: TL;DR: 「Persona 4 Revival」ではソーシャルリンクの最大化が「Golden」よりも容易になったが、プロデューサーは依然として簡単ではないと警告している。

items.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra model autonomously completes Portal in 24 hours — feat cost just $571 in tokens
items.description: An AI enthusiast has conducted an experiment where OpenAI's new GPT-6 Astra played through the entirety of Valve's Portal 3D puzzler game on its own.

items.description: A modder has created a ReShade add-on that runs Nvidia's DLSS 5 Neural Rendering on a second GPU, rendering the game on the first GPU to share the performance load.
items.tldr: モッダーがNvidiaのDLSS 5 Neural Renderingを第二のGPUで実行するReShadeアドオンを開発し、ゲームを第一のGPUでレンダリングしてパフォーマンス負荷を分散させることで、FPSを最大127%向上させることに成功しました。

items.title: Montech Century II Gold 850W power supply review: Excellent budget-friendly Gold-tier ATX 3.1 unit with Cybenetics Platinum efficiency
items.description: At $90, the Montech Century II Gold 850W ATX 3.1 is a low-cost Gold-tier ATX 3.1 unit with a native 12V-2x6 connector, Cybenetics Platinum efficiency at both 115V and 230V input, and a matte silver chassis.
items.tldr: TL;DR: Montech Century II Gold 850Wは、90ドルで購入できるコストパフォーマンスに優れたGold-tier ATX 3.1電源ユニットで、Cybenetics Platinum効率を持ち、12V-2x6コネクタを備えています。

items.title: GTA Vice City and GTA III return to web browsers after a DMCA takedown — Open-source reverse engineering brings the classics to the web with over 100 FPS performance
items.description: You can play GTA: Vice City and GTA III in your browser right now across pretty much any modern device. The projects are compiled from source codes of the original games and are available on either DOS Zone, where you're required to upload or torrent a few assets, or Quenq.
items.tldr: GTA: Vice CityとGTA IIIがオープンソースのリバースエンジニアリングにより、ブラウザでプレイ可能になり、100 FPS以上のパフォーマンスを実現しています。

items.title: Adobe Patches Magento Zero-Day Exploited to Deploy Rust Backdoor and PHP Web Shell
items.description: Adobe on Monday released security patches to address a maximum-severity flaw impacting Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that has come under active exploitation in the wild. items.title: BengalSEO Poisons Bing Search Results to Deliver MayaBot and Tech Support Scams
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a sprawling search engine optimization (SEO) poisoning campaign that paves the way for malware deployment and tech support scams. items.title: 220 million traveler records exposed in Vietnam-linked APIS leak
items.description: Exclusive: An exposed Advance Passenger Information System (APIS) database held 220 million passenger and crew records containing names, passport numbers, dates of birth, nationalities, and flight details spanning 2017 to 2026. items.title: Grindr to Pay £26 Million to Settle U.K. Claims Over HIV Status Data Sharing
items.description: Online dating app Grindr has opted to pay £26 million ($35.1 million) to settle a lawsuit in the U.K. over allegations that it shared users' personal information, including their HIV status, with third-parties. items.tldr: Grindrは、ユーザーのHIVステータスを含む個人情報を第三者と共有したとして、イギリスでの訴訟を解決するために2600万ポンド（約3億5100万ドル）を支払うことに決めました。

items.title: PEEP Turns Chrome and Edge Into Post-Compromise Backdoors for Host Command Execution
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a complex Chromium-based post-exploitation toolkit called PEEP that masquerades as a bookmarks extension for the web browser. items.title: Magento StyleSmuggler zero-day exploited to deploy Linux backdoor

items.title: Fake IT Calls Target Executives in Microsoft 365 Data Theft and Extortion Attacks

items.tldr: Microsoft 365を狙ったデータ盗難と恐喝の脅威が、ITヘルプデスクのフィッシングや中間者攻撃によるトークン盗難を通じて広がっていることが報告されました。

items.title: BigBear Microsoft 365 phishing service bypassed MFA at 258 organizations

items.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: Chrome 0-Day, Router Hijacks, Coder Supply Chain Attack and More

items.tldr: 今週のサイバーセキュリティニュースでは、Chromeの0-Day脆弱性、ルーターのハイジャック、コーダーのサプライチェーン攻撃などが報告され、メール画像をオフにしてもテキストから生成されたQRコードが表示される問題が浮上しました。

items.title: Your Cloud Security Checklist Doesn't Work the Way You Think It Does

items.tldr: クラウドプロバイダーごとに異なる失敗があり、2026年のクラウドセキュリティインデックスによると、AWS、Azure、Google Cloudの3,000組織からのデータ分析でリスクプロファイルがほぼ同じであることが明らかになった。

items.title: Rogue ScreenConnect Clients Spread Four-Stage VBScript Chain to Newly Connected Hosts
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of worm-like activity that abuses ConnectWise ScreenConnect to distribute a malicious Visual Basic Script (VBScript) payload to newly connected systems. items.tldr: ConnectWise ScreenConnectを悪用して、新たに接続されたシステムに悪意のあるVBScriptペイロードを配布するワームのような活動が報告されており、Huntressによると、異なる初期アクセス手法を用いた3件の無関係な事例が確認されています。
